sources.title: AcDbDatabase::wblockCloneObjects
sources.finding: When the supplied owner is a dictionary, newly cloned entries are anonymous. The caller supplies the operation-level duplicate-record policy; documentation separately identifies INSERT and database insert as Ignore.

sources.title: XRECORD (DXF)
sources.finding: XRECORDs disappear when read into AutoCAD releases before R13c4; this statement concerns DXF reads.

assessment: A direct wblockCloneObjects call into the target dictionary cannot alone establish the behavior of a named SAME_KEY collision; capture the actual keys and ID mapping and separately test an applicable INSERT or merge operation.
Record the exact native release and maintenance level for XRECORD DXF readback. AC1012 and successful open do not prove XRECORD preservation.
Neither source establishes the in-memory mergeStyle of an AC1012 dictionary with an absent serialized field, nor native DWG open or merge behavior. Continue strict refusal pending the witness.
changes: Updated native witness procedure and P6 remaining queue.
limits: No native process was run; no product behavior or support claim was changed.
